what: A partial run of case 80-82, sealed, whose artifacts are kept under heldout_original_superseded/ and seals_superseded/

why_discarded.detail: The pass was stopped because five driver scripts were edited after it began. Those edits came from an integration check run against SUPERSEDED-in-repo but already-published S5A artifacts in a scratch directory, and from reading the run log for token usage lines. No held-out gold was read at any point and no held-out result was inspected. Keeping the three traces would nevertheless have meant the held-out block was produced by two different code versions, which is the thing §5.1's 'same frozen code' and the one-pass rule exist to prevent.
why_discarded.not_a_result_judgement: The three traces were not rejected for what they showed. They were never scored: no seal was verified in the pipeline, no reference was opened, no judge was called on them, and no outcome verdict exists for case 80, 81 or 82 from this pass.
why_discarded.not_an_infrastructure_failure: §5.2's rerun clause covers network, 5xx, process exit and filesystem failure. This is none of those, and it is not reported as one. It is recorded here instead because the alternative — silently deleting three sealed traces — would be the same as never mentioning that the block was started twice.

what_was_preserved.artifacts: heldout_original_superseded/ — the full per-case artifact set the three runs wrote, including events, ledger, deltas, bindings, integrity, replay reports and provenance graphs
what_was_preserved.seals: seals_superseded/ — the three seal records, so the superseded artifacts can still be hash-checked

effect_on_the_final_block.final_block: case 80-137, all 58 run from case 80 under the final driver code
effect_on_the_final_block.case_80_81_82_in_final_block: re-run from scratch; their final artifacts are the ones under heldout_original/, not these
effect_on_the_final_block.drift_status: every post-freeze driver edit now predates the first seal of the final pass, which is what driver_drift_report.json checks

freeze_manifest_unchanged.why: §4 fixes the freeze before case 80 is read, and case 80-82 were read in the discarded pass. Re-writing the manifest now would make its hashes match the final code while destroying the property it was created to establish. It is left exactly as written at 2026-09-20T04:34:18Z, and the post-freeze edits are disclosed by name in driver_drift_report.json instead.
